instrument_name: Massachusetts DOR Withholding Tax Guide (posted August 2026)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employers withhold MA tax from residents (any work location) and nonresidents (MA services). New employees complete W-4 and M-4. Methods: Circular M tables or percentage method; exemption amounts weekly 19 x n + 66, biweekly 38 x n + 131, semimonthly 42 x n + 141, monthly 83 x n + 284, annual 1,000 x n + 3,400. Deposit: <=100 annual; 101-1,200 quarterly; 1,201-25,000 monthly; >25,000 quarterly return with 3-business-day payments at >=500. Payroll service providers (third-party bulk filers) must e-file and e-pay. Guide has no local-tax section.

instrument_name: Massachusetts Circular M 2026 (5.0%, effective 2026-01-01), Wayback copy
figure_or_rule_carried: Rate 5.0%; surtax threshold 1,107,750 (2026): annual tax above it at 9%. Percentage method excludes supplemental wages. Supplemental (bonus): withhold 5% if annualized regular wages + prior supplemental + payment <= 1,107,750; above: lesser of 9% of payment or 9% of excess over threshold, plus 5% of remainder. Head of household credit weekly 2.31/biweekly 4.62/semimonthly 5.00/monthly 10.00; blind 2.12/4.23/4.58/9.17. Exemption factor claiming 1: weekly 85, biweekly 169, semimonthly 183, monthly 367, annual 4,400. Chrome could not read the PDF (unreadable-pdf).

instrument_name: Massachusetts DUA: Employer contributions to unemployment
figure_or_rule_carried: 2026 new employers (<3 years) 2.42%; new construction employers 6.08%; established per DUA notice. Reports and payments quarterly, due Apr 30/Jul 31/Oct 31/Jan 31. Late interest 12%. Wage base not on page. No employee contribution mentioned on page.

instrument_name: M.G.L. c.151A s.14 (UI taxable wage base), Wayback copy
figure_or_rule_carried: UI taxable wage base is $15,000 for calendar years beginning on or after 2015-01-01.

instrument_name: Massachusetts DFML PFML employer contribution rates
authority: MA Department of Family and Medical Leave
figure_or_rule_carried: 2026: 0.88% of eligible wages (employers 25+): family 0.18% (up to 100% from employee) + medical 0.70% (employee up to 40% = 0.28%, employer 60% = 0.42%). Employers <25: 0.46% with no employer medical share. Individual contributions capped at the Social Security taxable maximum. 2027 (Ch.101 Acts of 2026): employer contribution shifts from medical leave to family leave (page 2027 table). Official PFML contribution calculator linked on page.

instrument_name: VEC FAQ: How are tax rates assigned?
